title: Rational Design of Immune Gene Therapy Combinations via In Vivo CRISPR Activation Screen of Tumor Microenvironment Modulators
model: E0771 cells, APCM CRISPRa library (107 guides, 36 immune genes), intravenous lung metastases in C57BL/6J mice
contrast: Lung tumors vs injected cell pool (14 vs 2; tumors from 5 mice)
paper_method: Not stated in the available text (paper not open access)
paper_calls: Top immunostimulatory candidates Cd80, Tnfsf14, Cxcl10, Tnfsf18, Tnfsf9 and Ifng
barcs_calls: 3 genes at FDR 0.10 (Cd80, Tnfsf18, Tnfsf14, all depleted); no controls, so no control null
named_hits: Depletion ranks of 36 genes: Cd80 #1, Tnfsf18 #2, Tnfsf14 #3 (FDR <= 0.002); Cxcl10 #4 (FDR 0.30); Tnfsf9 #6 and Ifng #7 (FDR 0.80)
verdict: The paper's six candidates are six of BARCS's seven most depleted genes, and Cd80, Tnfsf18 and Tnfsf14 pass FDR 0.01; Cxcl10, Tnfsf9 and Ifng rest on one or two guides and do not pass. The library has no non-targeting controls and several tumors share a mouse, so the FDR could not be calibrated and is likely optimistic.
